column1: # ARC 3 / R13 -- THE ADJUDICATED CEILINGS OF THE EXTERNAL-TRUTH FLOW
# One row per (leg, isa).  A leg's HEADLINE is the count of rows where the
# tracer drops information a reference states, or where the difference is not
# understood.  The CEILING is the value a maintainer has adjudicated, row by
# row, in the verdict named in ADJUDICATION.  The gate FAILS when a headline
# EXCEEDS its ceiling, when a report is missing, when a headline cannot be
# parsed, or when the leg's scored population is below FLOOR.
# A ceiling is never a target.  RETIRED_BY names the work item whose landing
# must lower it; a ceiling with no RETIRED_BY is one this project accepts as
# a property of the reference, not of the trace.

column7: adjudication

THE EIGHT BARE ARMS' EXIT CODES: rc=0/unallowed=0 on each; the ceiling is the count of arms that did not exit 0.  IT SCORES THE BARE HALF ONLY, AND SAYS SO (FINDING 72-F).  The eight `--srcenc` arms cannot be scored on rc here: they carry the boundary residue as `unallowed` (2,877 signatures across four ISAs at exec126's tip), so they exit 1 by construction and a ceiling over their exit codes would be a number about that residue rather than about the allowlist.  The residue is the subject of exec124's ITEM3_BOUNDARY_ROWS.md and closes there, not here.  What the srcenc arms CAN answer -- and what this row's population structurally cannot -- is the dead-allowlist-rule question, because the two arm shapes are partial in COMPLEMENTARY read families: a bare arm exempts the whole SR-rd-* family from its dead-rule detector and a --srcenc arm exempts R-rd-*/FR-rd-*.  That question is scored by the isaxdead rows below, one per shape, and both reports must be present for the union to cover the allowlist.  ARMS ACCOUNTED FOR, NOT ARMS SCORED -- FINDING 99-A.  The gate runs two LAYERS per ISA, so this shape has eight arms and this floor counts them.  Since exec170 a BARE arm SKIPS the fields layer: that layer's classification comes from QEMU's `decode_id`, which is read from the sled's mechanism corpus, and a bare arm has no corpus and so no identity -- running it anyway is what made every encoding read GEN_OP_UNKNOWN and turned this gate from 20/20 into 8-of-20 while nothing on the wire moved (98-F).  The skip is the layer's contract, and the arm shape says so on its own roll-up line (`fields_layer_skipped=`).  So the floor is met by scored arms PLUS arms declared skipped -- 4+4 here -- and it is NOT lowered to 4, because an arm that is neither scored nor declared is exactly the hole a floor is for, and a floor of 4 would pass a bare report that had also lost its boundary layer.  A report SHORT of this floor with no roll-up line is a refusal naming the missing line, never a silent skipped=0; score.py's `accounted()` carries the rule and external_truth_gate.sh's ARM G proves all four readings

THE SAME FACT ON THE `--srcenc` HALF, AND THE ROW FINDING 72-F EXISTS FOR.  At PASS 72 `x86_64 SR-rd-phantom ffree +REG_FCSR,REG_FPR#,REG_SEG0` went DEAD two commits after it landed -- 24513de116 withdrew ffree's survivor row, so the phantom signature it excused stopped existing -- the x86_64 fields --srcenc arm PRINTED `dead_allow_rules=1` on its own summary line, and the R13 gate passed 17 of 17.  The gate was RIGHT to: the eight arms in its evidence root were the bare ones, where the whole SR-rd-* family is exempt from the detector because a bare arm never asks the question.  A detector nobody reads is not a detector, so the srcenc arms enter the evidence root for the question they can answer.  Re-measured at exec126: the dead row was still the ONLY one across all sixteen arms, and it is removed at the landing tip.  The rc ceiling for these arms stays out of the gate for the reason written on the isax row above

THE UNALLOWED RESIDUE ON THE `--srcenc` ARMS.  The row exists because these eight arms had NO scored number at all -- FINDING 90-C.  `isax` scores EXIT CODES and its comment says why it can only be asked of the bare half: a `--srcenc` arm carries its residue as `unallowed` and so exits 1 by construction.  True; and what follows is that the NUMBER needs a row, not that the arms go unscored.  Unscored is what they were: at exec148's evidence root the arms read 6, 6, 3, 3 and 0 x4, four exited 1, and the gate PASSED 19 of 19 unable to see it.  THE CEILING WAS 18 AND IS NOW 12, AND THE REASON THE OTHER SIX RETIRED IS NOT THE REASON THE TWELVE REMAIN.  The 18 was nine signatures scored twice, one per layer, `SR-rd-*` being layer-independent.  The MIPSEL three -- `SR-rd-phantom {addu.qb, addu_s.qb, shll.qb} +REG_FLAGS` -- were a REGENERATION OWED and nothing else: the generator's M-DSPCTL class already claims them (DSPControl is read-modify-written by set_DSPControl_overflow_flag(), target/mips/tcg/dsp_helper.c, and a merging partial write reads the word it preserves per R17), and the generated `SR-rd-*` block simply had not been re-emitted since the signatures appeared.  REGENERATED at exec151 from a corpus captured at 9f0c5a03c0 (the tree that ships this file, which the generator's HEAD guard requires): mipsel 3 -> 0 on BOTH layers, aarch64 and riscv64 0 -> 0, dead_allow_rules 0 on all sixteen arms, and the two blocks re-emit byte-identically.  THE TWELVE THAT REMAIN ARE ONE NAMED TRACER DEFECT, NOT A PENDING REGENERATION, and the regeneration is what PROVED it: the same six signatures survived it.  `SR-rd-phantom {fldcw, fldenv, fninit, frstor, ldmxcsr, vldmxcsr} +REG_FCSR` are the generator's X-SELFRELOAD class, which carries `defect=True` and therefore emits NO rows by rule -- an allowlist row asserts the tracer is right, and laundering a defect through one is the failure that file's own header warns against.  The class's finding, in QEMU's call chain: helper_fldcw -> cpu_set_fpuc(env, val) (target/i386/cpu.h) assigns env->fpuc and then calls update_fp_status(env) (target/i386/tcg/fpu_helper.c), which reads back the word just stored and hands &env->fp_status to set_x86_rounding_mode() and set_floatx80_rounding_precision(), each writing ONE field -- so the access is stated as a read-modify-write and the file reaches the READ list.  ldmxcsr/vldmxcsr take the identical route through update_mxcsr_status(), fldenv/frstor through cpu_set_fpuc() on the word they restore, and fninit through do_fninit() -> cpu_set_fpuc(env, 0x37f) -- an immediate CONSTANT, which is the clearest statement of the shape: nothing architectural is consulted at all.  The value read is what this instruction wrote a statement earlier, so a row calling the tracer right would be recording a dependency on itself.  RETIRING THE 12 means a narrower statement at the re-derivation site or a ruling that a partially-rewritten derived file is a source -- a wire change either way, owing R13 legs -- so `retired_by` is none: no open ledger item closes this by itself.  A headline of 13 is a finding to open, not slack to spend.

exec35/pinrepro/EVIDENCE.md -- THE LEG IS REPRODUCIBLE NOW, SO THE CEILING IS THE MEASUREMENT.  #294 is closed AT SOURCE and the cause was not noise: qemu-user resolves the guest with realpath() and hands the result to it as AT_EXECFN (linux-user/main.c exec_path = real_exec_path; elfload.c NEW_AUX_ENT(AT_EXECFN, info->file_string)), so the guest stack -- and every pointer the delta model is built from -- moves with the LENGTH OF THE OUTPUT DIRECTORY PATH.  Measured: nine extra characters move rsp by 0x10; three runs at output-path length 60 read 278/278/278 and three at 51 read 266/266/266, which is the whole 265..278 span this row used to carry.  run_reg_arm.sh now runs both halves from a FIXED-WIDTH work directory (width asserted, symlink refused), pins CPU affinity (the native half CPUID leaf 1 EBX[31:24] read 0x03 on one run and 0x44 on the next), passes -seed 1 (qemu-user serves AT_RANDOM and getrandom from its own PRNG) and states RLIMIT_STACK.  THREE consecutive runs at output-path lengths 56 / 65 / 75 and TWO different guest-mapping placements: criterion 261 / 261 / 261, row multisets identical for two of the three pairs and differing in FOUR ORTHOGONAL rows for the third -- the two TLS canary-check sites and their two flag consumers, the one input no userspace flag can pin (the kernel draws AT_RANDOM per execve).  So the ceiling is 261 with NO MARGIN: the reproducible measurement is the authority, and a headline of 262 is a finding to open, not slack to spend.  #293 is closed in the same pass and IS the 265 -> 261: the two rules that convicted on the encoding alone are replaced by syscall_effects(), which asks each side whether IT performed the write -- r11 against its own rflags, rcx against its own next instruction address.  Both sides had; the disagreement was the flags word that arrived (PF alone, the #272 pointer-placement class), and the report now prints that adjudication per instance, unconditionally.  The tripwire still convicts: a planted arm that stops the tracer writing r11 reads QEMU-USER-SYSCALL-CLOBBER-NOT-PERFORMED:tracer-r11-is-not-its-own-rflags on 13 r11 + 2 flags rows and 261 -> 277.  THE DECOMPOSITION CLAUSE IS REFRESHED UNDER R19, AND THE CEILING WITH IT: 261 -> 259.  Two of the four terms the 261 was cut from RETIRED at 1cfa0b954f, which moved rdsspq's named GPR out of the published source list and into the destination where XED, iced-x86 and PIN's own dstset all put it.  Gone with it: the 1 TRACER-SUBSET SET row (PIN dstset ref_only=rax, tracer naming no destination at all) and the 1 destination the tracer named without a value (the same rax, which the reference valued and the tracer did not publish); the report's 'tracer named the destination without a value' line reads 0 where it read 1, and dst-set mismatched reads 0 where it read 1.  The measured criterion is now 259 and it decomposes into TWO terms: 258 UNACCOUNTED value rows (the pointer residue adjudicated at exec33, with the 2 ripsrc CODE-DELTA-UNESTABLISHED rows sitting inside it) + 1 TRACER-SUBSET value row (85c0 test rax, QEMU-USER-SYSCALL-RESULT-WRITTEN-OUTSIDE-THE-INSN-STREAM) = 259.  The row's own no-margin doctrine is what forces the ceiling down with the measurement: holding 261 would have left 2 of silent slack exactly where a source-list change can spend it, since a lost source arrives here as a TRACER-SUBSET row.  259 is reproduced THREE times at this tip -- verify40 and exec70 on the unmodified tree and exec70's post-flip leg with the source-list flip applied -- so the flip is proven not to move this leg, and a headline of 260 is a finding to open, not slack to spend.  The 2320 TRACER-SUPERSET set rows and the 19,925 ORTHOGONAL value rows are outside the criterion and unchanged in kind.  The wrong path is untouched.

exec112/depmap/DEPMAP_ADJUDICATION.md -- D3: the dependency map is wire content and R13 is a standing gate, so a map with no external leg was a hole in the gate's own rule.  THE CEILING IS THE MEASUREMENT, reproduced THREE times at this tip (loss 4/4/4, precision 12/12/12, 418 facts).  All FOUR loss rows are REFERENCE-SIDE and each is placed against the gem5 micro-op dump that produced it.  L1 REF-UOP-SHARED-SOURCE-LIST, 1 row: 0x401060 `shl %rbx,%cl` is ONE gem5 uop with THREE destinations and one shared source list, so the old flags reach the shifted VALUE; the wire puts that read on %flags alone, which is x86's count-zero flag-preserve stated exactly.  L2 REF-XOR-SWAP-IDIOM, 2 rows: 0x4010eb `xchg %rax,%rbx` is three XORs in gem5, all-to-all in the reference's own model and a pure swap in the ISA, which is what the wire states.  L3 REF-SCRATCH-REUSE, 1 row: 0x401063 `lock cmpxchg` threads the store datum AND the rax writeback through the same scratch t1, carrying %rbx into %rax; the wire names %rbx in sdata0 where it belongs.  In all four the tracer is the MORE PRECISE side, so RETIRED_BY is none -- this ceiling is a property of the reference.  aarch64 is 0 and is held at 0

exec112/depmap/DEPMAP_ADJUDICATION.md -- D3: the dependency map is wire content and R13 is a standing gate, so a map with no external leg was a hole in the gate's own rule.  THIS ROW IS aarch64's OWN MEASUREMENT, and it is a ZERO: loss 0/0/0 across three reproductions at this tip, over 309 scored facts against a floor of 250.  A zero means nothing here to adjudicate row by row -- there is no losing row -- so what has to be shown instead is that the instrument CAN convict on this ISA, and it does: on aarch64's own loss column drop-edge moves 0 -> 51, swap-addr-data 0 -> 44 and drop-addr-edge 0 -> 69.  Three of five falsifiers fire in the direction this row scores.  The two that do not -- add-edge 0 -> 0 and all-to-all 0 -> 0 -- cannot, because neither REMOVES an edge, and that is exactly why the precision direction is a separate scored row (depmapprec/aarch64, ceiling 28, one class P1 ADDR-REG-REACHES-VALUE, a disagreement with the harness's axis separation rather than with gem5).  RETIRED_BY is none: there is no loss to retire.  CORRECTED IN PASS 66 (FINDING 65-D) -- this field previously carried x86_64's justification VERBATIM, reciting that ISA's four loss rows (`shl %rbx,%cl`, `xchg %rax,%rbx`, `lock cmpxchg`) as though they were this leg's, under a headline of 0.  A ceiling of zero cannot be justified by another ISA's losses, and a shared paragraph is not a shared measurement

exec112/depmap/DEPMAP_ADJUDICATION.md -- the PRECISION direction of the same report, held at its measurement for a reason the controls make concrete: `add-edge` and `all-to-all` move the loss column by 0 on both ISAs, and `all-to-all` drives x86_64's loss to 0 while flooding precision 12 -> 122.  A gate holding only the loss number would be blind to two of the five arms that prove this axis convicts, and would read a map publishing every input against every output as its best result ever.  12 rows, four classes: P1 ADDR-REG-REACHES-VALUE 2 (the harness routes address registers to load_addr by design; the wire names the base in the RMW flags and in pushfq's datum), P2 REF-X87-TOP-TAG-ONLY 4 (gem5's pop87 sources are TOP and tags; the wire also names %st(0), because the status word's exception bits are a function of the stored value), P3 REF-NO-FCSR-TRAFFIC 4 (the same class already adjudicated by name on gem5wp/mipsel -- the rounding mode selects the stored encoding and the reference does not model it), P4 TRACER-PAIR-OVER-APPROXIMATION 2 (fxch: the wire publishes both halves of the exchange where gem5's movfp chain is precise).  P4 is the ONLY class where the reference is the more precise side; it loses nothing, and retiring it is an x87-exchange refiner rather than a wire change

exec112/depmap/DEPMAP_ADJUDICATION.md -- 28 rows, ONE class, reproduced three times at this tip: P1 ADDR-REG-REACHES-VALUE.  gem5_depmap.py routes a load's address registers to load_addr and gives the loaded value an LD token, so on the reference side an address register never appears in a value's set -- while gem5's own micro-op names integer:20 as a source of vector:0 on the very rows scored.  The disagreement is with the HARNESS's axis separation, not with gem5.  By encoding: LDR 5, LD1 11, LDP 2, LD2 2, LD3 3, LD4 4, LD1R 1 = 28.
